title: Follow-up delegation: narrow window between re-arm and dispatch can lose the follow-up turn
outcome:
Found in the /review-with-delegate pass on tm-px5 (Codex P1, partially fixed). followup_delegation now
does gate+re-arm atomically (one lock) then RELEASES the lock and calls dispatch_turn_and_snapshot. In
the window between the re-arm commit (status=Running, but the child is still Idle holding its prior
## Result packet) and the dispatch (which makes the child Active), a CONCURRENT status/result poll ->
refresh_delegation_from_child_locked sees Running + child Idle-with-packet -> re-Completes the delegation
with the STALE result. The delegation is then terminal again while the follow-up turn is about to / does
run -> the follow-up's real result is lost (delegation stuck Completed).

Narrow (needs a concurrent poll from another thread during the ~2-lock-acquisition window; the normal
single-parent MCP flow calls followup then waits, so it doesn't hit it), but real. Proper fix: a
transitional 'Resuming' state (or a child 'starting' marker) that refresh_delegation_from_child_locked
respects so it will not re-derive completion until the new turn produces a result. src/delegations.rs
followup_delegation / refresh_delegation_from_child_locked / delegation_child_outcome.
